SOLD!
Modern Mojo Living: 4x3 Townhouse! Experience contemporary living at its finest in this beautifully finished, 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom double-storey townhouse. Built in 2021 within the sought-after Mojo Urban Living in Cockburn Central, this home offers a seamless move-in experience, allowing you to immediately enjoy its stylish design and vibrant surroundings!
Entering through a secure, gated front courtyard with low-maintenance artificial lawn, you're immediately greeted by the home's inviting atmosphere. Inside, a spacious, open-plan living area flows effortlessly into a well-appointed kitchen. Featuring stone benchtops, 900mm under bench oven, gas cooktop, stainless steel rangehood, double sink, pantry, and dishwasher recess, this kitchen is designed for both functionality and style. A conveniently located laundry nook sits just off the kitchen, adding to the home's practicality. The ground floor also offers a comfortable, carpeted fourth bedroom with its own ensuite, perfect for guests. Stepping outside, a paved rear courtyard with a small lawn area provides a private space for outdoor enjoyment and pets.
Ascend the staircase to discover the upper level, where a spacious master bedroom awaits, complete with plush carpeting and a generous walk-in robe. The master ensuite features a vanity, shower and toilet. Two additional carpeted bedrooms, each with built-in robes, provide comfortable accommodations. A well-appointed main bathroom offers a vanity, shower and bath, along with a separate toilet for added convenience.
Beyond the comforts of home, outdoor experiences are readily available. With close access to parklands, sporting ovals, basketball courts, BBQ areas, and playgrounds, you'll find ample opportunities for recreation. The nearby Beeliar wetlands, including South Lake, North Lake, and Little Rush Lake, also inspire fun adventures with beautiful hikes and nature walks just a stone's throw away.
PROPERTY FEATURES;
• Handy under stair storage
• Ducted reverse cycle air conditioning
• Quality flooring & LED lighting
• Solar panels
• Easy care courtyard
• Gas hot water system
• Paved courtyard with lawn area
• Double lockup garage accessible via rear laneway

Renovated Family Luxury, Resort-Style Pool & The Ultimate Workshop!
Five bedrooms, stunning renovations, resort-style entertaining , low maintenance living and secure parking for six vehicles - this exceptional family home really does have it all!
Kasey Summers is excited to bring to market 12 Lodge Court, Cockburn Central, an impressive five-bedroom family home combining beautifully renovated interiors, multiple living areas, outstanding outdoor entertaining and exceptional workshop and parking facilities.
Perfectly positioned in a peaceful cul-de-sac within a quiet single-entry estate, this outstanding property sits on a generous block and offers a wonderful sense of privacy while remaining conveniently close to schools, shopping, transport and recreational facilities.
Originally built in 2000 and extensively improved over the years, this is a home where all the hard work has been done, allowing its new owners to simply move in, relax and enjoy!  Step inside and discover a spacious, versatile floorplan designed to accommodate the needs of a growing family.
At the heart of the home is the stunning renovated kitchen, showcasing stylish stone benchtops, an enlarged island bench and beautiful feature pendant lighting that adds a touch of sophistication. Overlooking the open-plan family and meals area, this inviting space is ideal for everyday living and effortless entertaining.  The adjoining dining area offers clever additional built-in pull-out storage, providing a practical and discreet solution for keeping everyday essentials neatly organised.
Both bathrooms have been beautifully renovated with stylish stone benchtops and mirrored shaving cabinets, offering contemporary finishes together with valuable additional storage.  Attractive wood-look vinyl plank flooring brings warmth and style throughout, while ducted reverse-cycle air conditioning ensures year-round comfort. Security doors provide an additional practical feature.
Multiple living zones provide excellent flexibility, including a separate lounge complete with a charming wood-burning fireplace, creating the perfect cosy retreat for those cooler winter evenings.  With five bedrooms or four bedrooms and a study and generous living areas, there is plenty of room for everyone to spread out, come together or enjoy their own space.
Outside is where this property truly comes into its own!  Designed for those who love to entertain, the impressive covered alfresco area is an entertainer's dream, featuring a beautiful cedar-lined ceiling, downlights and a ceiling fan.  The fantastic outdoor kitchen takes entertaining to another level, complete with a place for your BBQ, rangehood, allowing you to entertain without ever having to leave the party!  Adding to the atmosphere is an attractive aquaponic water feature, creating a wonderful focal point and a sense of tranquillity within this impressive outdoor setting.
Just beyond, the recently installed swimming pool creates your very own resort-style escape, complete with beautiful exposed aggregate surrounds and a dedicated poolside lounging area with its own patio.  Imagine spending warm summer afternoons relaxing beside the pool while the kids splash away, firing up the BBQ for friends and family, or enjoying a quiet evening surrounded by the soothing sounds of the water feature.
And just when you thought this home couldn't offer any more, the incredible parking and workshop facilities take it to another level!  With secure drive-through access and space to accommodate up to six vehicles, this property is a dream for car enthusiasts, tradies, hobbyists or families with additional vehicles and recreational toys.  The impressive workshop is equipped with three-phase power, water and lighting, offering outstanding versatility for those who need a functional workspace, additional storage or room for their next project.
Adding even more appeal is a 6kW solar power system, helping to keep household running costs down.
Situated within a quiet single-entry estate, conveniently located close to:
• The Local House Bar & Grill - 650m
• Cockburn Aquatic & Recreation Centre (ARC) - 750m
• Emmanuel Catholic College - 800m
• Cockburn Gateway Shopping Centre - 1.2km
• Cockburn Central Train Station - 1.4km
• Jandakot Primary School - 2.5km
• Aubin Grove Train Station - 3.9km
Offering the perfect blend of stylish renovations, generous family living, resort-style outdoor entertaining and incredible practical features, this property delivers so much more than meets the eye.  Whether you're searching for room for a growing family, your own private poolside escape, an entertainer's dream or the ultimate setup for vehicles and workshop space, this fantastic home ticks an impressive number of boxes. Cockburn Central
About Cockburn Central
Cockburn Central is the urban hub of the City of Cockburn. Relatively new and still expanding, the area has seen rapid growth in recent years and is primarily used for industrial and commercial purposes.
Life in Cockburn Central
The Cockburn Gateway Shopping Centre precinct is the central fixture of Cockburn Central. The busy establishment has a plethora of shops, amenities, cafes, eateries and exercise facilities. It is also home to the award-winning Gate Bar and Bistro, which is a very popular establishment within Cockburn. Across the road from this precinct is the Cockburn Central Railway Station, which connects to the Mandurah train line and offers easy and convenient access into Perth City.

# Furlong Street 周边 2 公里：house 市场证据调查（V2）

## 用户授权与版本

用户要求：“Furlong Street 道路附近2公里的范围都可以。这里是个开发区。”
本版本另建任务和资料快照，保留原 1 公里、2026-10-30 截止的作业。
本次信息截止：2026-11-04 Australia/Perth。新旧任务、资料、代码均有变化，不是单因素实验或稳定性检验。
“开发区”是待查线索，须区分规划容量、批准、开工、完工和当前在售，不预先断言具体地块的分区。

## 范围与对象

- 以此前保存的 Furlong Street 道路代表点（纬度 -32.1158872，经度 115.8494353）为固定工作中心，半径 2000 米直线距离。此点不是 11 号门牌中心；本次不采用沿整条道路外扩的缓冲区。
- REIWA/中介房源地图坐标可作为房源位置证据，必须注明为平台标点、不是测绘或产权边界证明；不能因 Nominatim 未返回门牌而断言其他来源也无法定位。
- 每个附近样本记录地址、实际 suburb、坐标来源、到工作中心距离和是否在 2000 米内。没有坐标的样本列为范围未确认，不靠街名猜测。
- 房型主对象是 house；平台标 House 但正文称 townhouse 的，保留双重标签、单列展示，不能声称为独立屋。unit/apartment/空地/开发地块不混入同类 house 对比。
- 坐标样本是主动选取的公开案例，不是全量成交或完整库存。即使多条在圈内，也不据此宣称圈内总体样本已齐全。
- suburb 整体与 Perth 数据只作单列背景，不能升级为 2 公里范围统计。不同房型、土地面积及卧室差异必须披露。

## 三个问题

### 1 价格变化与成交样本

优先比较最新资料中两个已完成、可比年度的 house 中位价及样本量。逐项记录来源字段、年份/准确起止、更新时间、地理范围、房型、指标。
若结构化数据只有 CalendarYear 标签，准确起止未明确则标未明确，不能自行补写发布日期。
同一页面当前滚动 12 个月与历史年度字段分开，2026 年未结束，不得把当前值称为完整 2026 日历年。
列圈内成交样本的成交价、日期、土地面积、卧室/卫浴及房型。不同房屋的成交价差不等于同房涨幅；不能据两宗房产判断区域价格趋势。

### 2 在售库存与开发供应

查同一 2 公里范围、同一 house 定义两个时点的在售数量。当前挂牌的报价、状态、访问时间与成交分栏。
公开站点的“及周边 suburbs”搜索总数、分页结果数、挑选的案例数不能作为圈内库存总量。
若缺历史完整快照，明确库存变化 missing。政府结构规划只支持规划事实；既往规划预计住宅数不能当当前待售/已批准/已开工/已完工套数。
列已取得规划资料、时间、原文页码和适用范围；不能凭结构图推定某门牌 R-code。缺少当期批准/开工/完工数据时照实记录。

### 3 静态负资产条件计算

教学假设：购价 AUD 1,000,000；贷款余额 AUD 800,000。不是用户真实财务信息，也不是目标房屋估值。
简化定义：当前市场价值小于固定贷款余额时，房产净权益为负；等于贷款余额时净权益为零。
计算临界市场价值、相对购价的价格下跌比例；列公式、带单位输入、结果与等于/低于临界值的区别。
百分数格式：比例 0.2 等于 20%；结果写百分数时表达式使用比例，不额外乘 100。需要约数时明确保留小数位。
基础计算不计交易成本、出售成本、税费和贷款余额变化。条件算术正确不等于市场预测，抗跌比例不等于下跌概率。

## 输出及核验要求

1. 简洁中文报告，范围说明、三事项证据表、支持/反对/缺口、条件计算和结论边界。
2. 每条事实就近引用 claim_key；证据表附来源、访问日期、数据期间、发布日期（若未给出则未给出）与核验状态。
3. 原始页面、页面内结构化数据、程序计算的距离、人工摘录和检索失败记录要区分来源类型；不得把派生数据称为页面逐字原文。
4. 绑定全部主语、数字、单位、时间、地理范围、房型及限定词。支持一部分时拆窄陈述或 missing，不能整条 supported；表格和标题也要遵守同样限制。
5. 只有核验通过的条件计算可输出肯定结果；缺证事实不凭模型记忆补全。可以交付清楚披露缺口的报告，不把资料不全写成资料齐全。
6. 资料快照中的网页金额依其原始符号记录；结构化金额标准化说明属于提取记录，须保留原始字段和转换来源，不伪装成网页自然语言。
7. 不输出保证收益或确定买入建议。房产完整风险评估超出本次三个事项。

## 执行约束

DeepSeek 六步框架，读取本版本冻结任务与资料；运行时不联网补抓。
最多三对提议/检查（6 个课堂操作单位），计划/报告/审查另计 API 和费用；最多 9 次 API，客户端费用预算不超过 CNY 5，不自动重试。
保留全部输入哈希、请求/返回、trace、失败与审查；旧报告仅作历史参照，不进入模型提示。
审查通过不等于独立人工复核通过；human_review 单独记录，不手改 done。RACE/FACT 未运行、未提交。

### 事项 3：静态负资产条件计算

**教学假设（非用户真实财务信息，非目标房屋估值）：**
- 购价 AUD 1,000,000 [[Q3C1]]。
- 固定贷款余额 AUD 800,000 [[Q3C2]]。

**简化定义：**
- 当前市场价值等于固定贷款余额时，房产净权益为零 [[Q3C3]]。
- 当前市场价值小于固定贷款余额时，房产净权益为负 [[Q3C4]]。

**临界市场价值（核验通过）：**
- 净权益为零的临界市场价值等于固定贷款余额 AUD 800,000 [[Q3C5]]。
- 公式：临界市场价值 = 贷款余额；输入：贷款余额 = AUD 800,000；结果：AUD 800,000。

**相对购价的下跌比例：**
- 该比例候选（Q3C6）因未绑定数值锚点 percent:20 未通过核验，本报告不输出其肯定结果。
- 教学公式（仅作方法说明，不输出肯定数值）：下跌比例 = (购价 − 贷款余额) / 购价；输入：购价 AUD 1,000,000、贷款余额 AUD 800,000。该比例结果未通过核验，故不在此给出肯定数值。

**等于/低于临界值的区别：**
- 等于临界值 AUD 800,000 时净权益为零 [[Q3C3]][[Q3C5]]；低于临界值时净权益为负 [[Q3C4]]。

**计算边界：**
- 基础计算不计交易成本、出售成本、税费和贷款余额变化 [[Q3C7]]。
- 条件算术正确不等于市场预测，抗跌比例不等于下跌概率 [[Q3C8]]。
